obernants.domain: Bounded synthetic valid structures and valid source indices, fixed environment; finite numeric interpretation where required. n<=64 for steps oracle and <=256 DAG pool indices. No external models, teacher, GPU, corpora, held-out or large training.
obernants.observation_scope: qworld and deduct consume steps::Prob with aligned qs/descs. qworld rates change no cell immediately, but owner/thing context is updated before operation selection and can affect subsequent bare quantities. qread Set adds whereas qworld Set overwrites; qread's final event fold respects upto, while direct/relation/movement/initial-state decisions can inspect future events, so the complete function is not a prefix-state operator. steps oracle excludes repeated leaves; deduct gold can reuse a subtree but search excludes self-pairs. lex lookup requires caller normalization; understand does it. Missing-path test stops before Annotator load.
obernants.operator: Missing-path guard excludes loader effects; qworld rates exclude cell writes; valid DAG apply excludes invalid numeric interval; unknown-token Interp rejects before frame choice. These scoped exclusions do not compose into general English correctness.
